burro host add · add a server burro can run on

Usage: burro host add <name> <user@host[:port]> [-i key] [--force]

  -i key     ssh key for this server, skip it if plain ssh already works
  --force    replace a server with the same name

Example
  burro host add myserver root@203.0.113.10 -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Exit codes  0 added · 2 server unreachable or host key unknown · 4 name taken
